subject: Re: MGDT kickoff — compute plan locked
body:
Ulla,

Compute plan for the long pole is locked. We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation — 256 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-01 — for the large scaling run. Ines's reservation process went smoothly; that week gives us enough to train the biggest config and still replicate the two smaller points on the scaling curve. Everything before that (data pipeline shakeout, medium-scale training in May) fits on titan-a100 best-effort.

Staffing: Vera owns the offline Atari dataset ingest, Wanjiru the training infra, Yara evals and the fine-tuning recipe. No additional headcount ask this half.

One dependency to note: we want Evalline to host the per-game human-normalized scores, and Tomas's team quoted a 2-week integration. I've asked Yara to file that this week so it doesn't collide with the June run.

Jelena
